acceptance_criteria.description: Every frozen input and variant forecast hash verifies; predictions locked before its source local audit.
Every full-acquisition relative local waveform L2 error <=1e-5.
Every frozen unforced linear source relative energy drift over t=0..60 <=1e-6.

Each finest first-rise/first-fall residual <=1e-4, residual budget <=1e-4, and residual <= budget. Budget = mesh/time/domain residual changes + source/predictor output and surface sampling +1e-7. Missing events or excessive budget unresolved.
Source and full-prediction finest absolute event mesh change <=0.6 prior change + time/domain/sampling differences +1e-7; mesh plus nonspatial <=0.1. Otherwise unresolved.
Every finest prospective event change under output and surface decimation from .0125 to .025 <=1e-4. Otherwise unresolved.
